syllabusTopics: Kubernetes — resource limits, HPA, rolling updates, health probes
Helm — charts, values, templating, release management
CI/CD pipelines — stages, artifacts, triggers, secrets management
GitOps — ArgoCD / Flux, pull-based deployment model
Infrastructure as Code — Terraform (providers, state, modules, workspaces)
Cloud fundamentals — VPC, subnets, IAM, load balancers (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Alerting & SLOs — SLI/SLO/SLA, alert fatigue, runbooks
Service mesh — Istio / Linkerd (traffic management, mTLS, observability)
Secrets management — Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, sealed secrets
Container security — image scanning, least privilege, network policies, RBAC
Internal developer platform — golden paths, self-service, platform APIs
Incident management — on-call, postmortems, blameless culture, RCA
Cost optimization — rightsizing, spot instances, resource quotas, FinOps basics
Multi-tenancy — namespace isolation, RBAC, resource quotas per team
Networking — DNS, TLS/mTLS, service discovery, ingress controllers
